Sends authentication via custom header (X-API-Key)

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'auth' => { 'name' => 'X-API-Key', 'type' => 'header', 'value' => 'sk-test-key-12345' }, 'respect_robots_txt' => false }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.auth_header_sent.inspect
puts result.status_code.inspect
```
